author: sjm41
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
IPR013547 Prolyl 4-hydroxylase, N-terminal

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel CG34041 (FBgn0054041) Q2PDP5

* **Description of issue**
From my reading, this N-terminal domain is a non-catalytic, structural domain, so shouldn't be associated with the GO term [procollagen-proline 4-dioxygenase activity (GO:0004656)](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/GTerm?id=GO:0004656)

Dmel CG34041 has this N-terminal domain but lacks the catalytic domain (see PMID[40946811](http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/40946811/), and so I've annotated it with "NOT GO:0004656".
However, it's currently getting a positive annotation via IPR013547.
title: InterPro2GO issue: IPR013547 Prolyl 4-hydroxylase, N-terminal

author: tony787
body:
Hi Steven,
I have removed the term. This domain plays a role in the assembly but not in the catalysis.
Changes will be visible in the next InterPro release.
Best wishes,
Toni
